Meningioma arising in the meninges; mixed histology does not imply additional organ involvement.
ATP1A3-associated hemiplegia, movement disorder, seizures and developmental impairment; abnormal eye movements are neurologic manifestations.
Defined by chorioretinal degeneration and deficient pituitary hormone secretion.
Callosal abnormalities, developmental disability and colobomas define it; skeletal defects occur in 80-99%, and aortic aneurysm in 30-79% per annotations.
Congenital limb and vertebral dysostosis; spina bifida occulta alone does not establish neural damage.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with azoospermia and infertility; reproductive function has no axis.
Hereditary reduction of two-point tactile discrimination, supported by the nervous-system phenotype annotation.
Cerebellar malformations and developmental impairment with structural ocular disease; genital anomalies have no axis, and hair findings do not establish skin damage.
Benign tumour usually arising in subcutaneous fat; prominent intratumoral vessels do not establish a separate cardiovascular disorder.
Confluent and reticulated papillomatosis is a cutaneous keratinization disorder with hyperkeratosis.
Purely psychiatric impulse-control disorder without defining damage to an organ axis.
Autoimmune encephalopathy; cerebral vasculitis is annotated in 80-99%, supporting vascular involvement. Associated thyroiditis is a separate disease.
SCN2A-related infantile seizure disorder; occasional apnea and other episodic symptoms do not establish additional organ damage.
Sarcoma arising in breast tissue, which has no axis; synovial histology does not imply joint origin.
Infantile myoclonic epilepsy; developmental manifestations remain neurologic. Ocular abnormalities are occasional, below 30%.
Congenital limb-bone reduction and malformation complex; internal organs and intellectual function are usually normal.
Disordered glucagon secretion is an endocrine pancreatic disorder.
Obstetric and placental growth disorder; reduced fetal size alone does not establish damage to a covered organ.
Persistent linear cutaneous keratinization lesions define the disease.
Photosensitive brittle-hair and ichthyosis disorder; developmental or intellectual impairment affects over half. DNA repair defects alone do not establish a metabolic axis.
Systemic vascular malformation disorder; pulmonary AVMs occur in 29/65 (~45%) and cause shunting. Skin telangiectases and hepatic AVMs alone do not establish organ dysfunction.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, documented in 16/16 patients.
Inherited erythroid marrow failure; triphalangeal thumb and ventricular septal defect each occur in 1/1 annotated patient, supporting both axes with limited subtype data.
Mutilating keratoderma; ankylosis occurs in 80-99%, dental defects in 30-79%, and sensorineural hearing loss in 30-79% per annotations. Osteolysis is under 30%.
